def.short: the meal that people eat in the middle of the day
def.long: The meal that people eat in the middle of the day, usually between twelve and two o'clock. A lunch can be small, like a sandwich, or big, like a hot meal.

examples.en: What would you like for lunch?
Let's have lunch together on Friday.
examples.tr: Cuma günü birlikte öğle yemeği yiyelim.

examples.en: Kenji eats a sandwich and an apple for lunch.
examples.tr: Kenji öğle yemeğinde sandviç ve elma yiyor.

tr.note: Türkçede 'öğle yemeği' dersiniz; 'öğle' tek başına 'noon' demektir. Öğün adlarının önüne genellikle 'the' gelmez: have lunch. Geç kahvaltı ile öğle yemeğinin birleşimine 'brunch' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I eat the lunch at school.
mistakes.why: İngilizcede öğün adlarının önüne genellikle 'the' gelmez: have lunch, eat lunch. Türkçede 'öğle yemeğini yerim' dersiniz; belirtme eki 'the' gibi duyulabilir.

quiz.cloze: Many people eat a sandwich in the middle of the day. This meal is called ______.

def.short: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
def.long: The main meal of the day, which most people eat in the evening. You can have dinner at home, with friends, or in a restaurant.

examples.en: What's for dinner tonight?
Ayşe invited us to dinner at her house.
examples.tr: Ayşe bizi evinde akşam yemeğine davet etti.

examples.en: Sam cooks dinner for his family every Sunday.
examples.tr: Sam her pazar ailesi için akşam yemeği pişiriyor.

etymology.text: From Old French 'disner', which meant 'to break one's fast'. So 'dinner' and 'breakfast' share a similar idea.

tr.note: 'Dinner' günün ana yemeğidir ve çoğunlukla akşam yenir; hafif akşam yemeğine 'supper' denir. İngiltere'nin bazı yerlerinde öğle yemeğine de 'dinner' diyenler vardır.

quiz.cloze: We usually have ______ at 7 p.m., after work, and then we watch TV.

def.micro: list of food in a restaurant
def.short: a list of the food and drinks that you can order in a restaurant
def.long: A list of the food and drinks that you can order in a restaurant or café. It can be on paper, on a board, or on your phone.

examples.en: Can I see the menu, please?
The menu has fish, pasta, and a few salads.
examples.tr: Menüde balık, makarna ve birkaç salata var.

examples.en: Ayşe read the menu and ordered a soup.
examples.tr: Ayşe menüyü okudu ve bir çorba sipariş etti.

tr.note: Türkçede 'menü' hem yemek listesini hem hızlı yemek zincirlerindeki hazır paketi ('hamburger menü') anlatır. İngilizcede 'menu' genellikle listedir; hazır paket için 'combo' ya da 'value meal' denir.

mistakes.wrong: Can I take the menu, please?
mistakes.right: Can I see the menu, please?
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'menüyü alabilir miyim?' dersiniz; 'almak' çoğu zaman 'take' sanılır. İngilizcede menü istemek için 'Can I see the menu?' ya da 'Can I have the menu?' denir.

quiz.cloze: The waiter gave us the ______, and we chose soup and fish.

def.short: a day or more when you do not have to work or go to school
def.long: A day or a longer time when you do not have to work or go to school. In British English, 'a holiday' is also a trip for fun: people say 'go on holiday'. Americans say 'vacation'.

examples.en: Tomorrow is a holiday, so we don't work.
We are going on holiday to Spain in August.
The school holidays start next week.

tr.note: Türkçede 'tatil' hem boş günü hem seyahati anlatır. İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'on holiday', Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'on vacation' denir. Resmî tatile 'public holiday' denir.

mistakes.wrong: We go to holiday every summer.
mistakes.right: We go on holiday every summer.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'tatile gitmek' (yönelme hâli, -e) dersiniz, bu yüzden 'to' denir. İngilizcede 'go on holiday' kalıbı kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: We will make holiday in Bodrum.
mistakes.right: We will have a holiday in Bodrum.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'tatil yapmak' dersiniz; 'yapmak' çoğu zaman 'make' ya da 'do' sanılır. İngilizcede 'have a holiday' ya da 'go on holiday' denir.

quiz.cloze: Tomorrow is a public ______, so schools and banks are closed.

def.micro: time away for rest or travel
def.short: a time when you do not work or study and often travel for fun
def.long: A time away from work or school when you rest or travel for fun. Americans say 'go on vacation'; in British English people usually say 'go on holiday'.

examples.en: We are on vacation this week.
Maria is planning a vacation in Italy.
Mehmet has two weeks of vacation every year.
examples.tr: Mehmet'in her yıl iki haftalık tatili var.

etymology.text: From Latin 'vacatio', meaning 'freedom from work'. It is related to 'vacant' (empty).

tr.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'vacation' tatildir; İngiliz İngilizcesinde aynı şey için 'holiday' denir. İngiltere'de 'vacation' çoğunlukla üniversite tatilleri için kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: We go to vacation in July.
mistakes.right: We go on vacation in July.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'tatile gitmek' (yönelme hâli, -e) dersiniz, bu yüzden 'to' denir. İngilizcede 'go on vacation' kalıbı kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: My family and I are going on ______ to the beach for two weeks.

def.short: a building or room with many books that you can read or borrow
def.long: A building or room with many books that people can read there or borrow for free. You can also study, use a computer, or find information in a library.

examples.en: I borrow books from the library.
The library is quiet, so it's a good place to study.
examples.tr: Kütüphane sessiz, bu yüzden çalışmak için iyi bir yer.

examples.en: Mehmet returned three books to the library today.
examples.tr: Mehmet bugün üç kitabı kütüphaneye geri verdi.

etymology.text: From Latin 'librarium', a place for books, from 'liber' (book).

tr.note: Türkçede evdeki kitap dolabına da 'kütüphane' denir; İngilizcede ona 'bookcase' denir. 'Library' kitap ödünç verilen yerdir; kitap satılan yere 'bookstore' denir.
tr.mnemonic: 'Library' 'LAY-bre-ri' diye okunur, 'li' değil. Latincede 'liber' kitap demektir: kitapların yeri.

quiz.cloze: I don't want to buy this book. I will borrow it from the ______.

def.short: a building where you can see art, old objects, or other interesting things
def.long: A building where people can look at art, old objects, or other interesting things from history or science. Many cities have a museum for art, for history, or for science.

examples.en: The museum opens at nine o'clock.
Is the museum open on Mondays?
Kenji took his children to the science museum.

etymology.text: From Greek 'mouseion', meaning 'a place for the Muses', the goddesses of arts and learning.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'müze' ile aynı kökten gelir; İngilizcede üç heceli ve vurgu ortadadır: mju-ZEE-um. Yazarken 'z' değil 's' kullanılır: museum.

quiz.cloze: We saw old paintings, statues, and tools at the ______ yesterday.

def.short: a shop where you can buy medicine and other health products
def.long: A shop where you can buy medicine, including the medicine that your doctor tells you to take. It also sells things like soap and vitamins.

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
examples.tr: Buraya yakın bir eczane var mı?

examples.en: I need to go to the pharmacy for my medicine.
The pharmacy on the corner is open all night.

tr.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'drugstore' ya da 'pharmacy', İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'chemist' ya da 'pharmacy' denir. 'Nöbetçi eczane' için 'late-night pharmacy' gibi bir açıklama kullanılır.
tr.mnemonic: 'Ph' harfleri 'f' okunur: 'FAR-mı-si'. İlaç bilimi 'farmakoloji' de aynı Yunanca kökten gelir.

quiz.cloze: I have a headache, so I'm going to the ______ to buy some medicine.

def.short: a large shop where you choose food and other things and pay at the end
def.long: A large shop where you take food, drinks, and things for the home from shelves and pay for them before you leave. Many people go to the supermarket once a week.

examples.en: I need to go to the supermarket.
The supermarket closes at ten o'clock tonight.
examples.tr: Süpermarket bu gece saat onda kapanıyor.

examples.en: Ayşe buys milk, eggs, and bread at the supermarket.
examples.tr: Ayşe süpermarketten süt, yumurta ve ekmek alıyor.

tr.note: Türkçede bakkal ve küçük dükkânlara da 'market' dersiniz. İngilizcede 'market' çoğunlukla açık hava pazarıdır (ABD'de bazen süpermarket de olur); büyük mağazaya 'supermarket' denir.

quiz.cloze: We buy milk, eggs, and vegetables at the ______ every Saturday.

def.short: a place where planes take off and land, and where passengers wait
def.long: A place with long roads where planes take off and land, and with buildings where passengers wait and check in. Big cities often have more than one airport.

examples.en: The airport is far from the city center.
We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
examples.tr: Uçuştan iki saat önce havalimanına vardık.

examples.en: Ali's mother is waiting for him at the airport.

tr.note: Türkçede 'havalimanı' ve 'havaalanı' aynı anlama gelir; İngilizcede tek sözcük vardır: 'airport'. Büyük havalimanlarında 'terminal' denen ayrı binalar bulunur.
tr.mnemonic: 'Air' hava, 'port' liman demek: 'airport' tıpkı Türkçedeki gibi hava + liman.

quiz.cloze: My plane leaves at six, so I must be at the ______ at four.
